notes.title: NEW UPDATE! It's our answer to your feedback!
notes.content:
[h3]We have released an update for Escape Room VR: Inner Voices that fixes the reported issues, mostly related to the optimization.[/h3]

[b]BUGFIX:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed problem with blurring. Now you can set up pixel density by yourself! Be careful - performance depends on the possibilities of your graphic card.
[*] Fixed issue with lags. We did our best to optimize the code and make it lighter for your computer, so right now, it should go smooth!
[*] Default subtitles off. You can switch on subtitles in the game menu.
[*] VR launch options. We have changed the look, and it's more user friendly.
[*] Minor bug fixes. Some changes that you won't feel.
[/list]

[b]IN PROGRESS:[/b]
[list]
[*] Valve Index Support.
[*] Full, smooth locomotion. With continuous turn that will let you fully immerse in the game.
[*] ... and of course, other bugs which you report to us :).
[/list]

Stay tuned! The next update is coming soon. Join us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/DQa2m45]Discord[/url]! Your feedback gets to us faster that way.
